screener.title: Screener
screener.description: Validated screener id. Defaults to ahc-hrsn (the only allow-listed screener).

housing.title: Housing
housing.description: Housing domain responses — 2 comma-separated integers (living-situation code, quality-problem count). >=1 on either screens positive.

food.title: Food
food.description: Food domain responses — 2 comma-separated integers (worried, ran-out). >=1 on either screens positive.

safety.title: Safety
safety.description: Interpersonal-safety HITS — 4 comma-separated integers (1-5 each). Total >10 screens positive and raises a red flag.

patientConsent.title: Patient Consent
patientConsent.description: Set to true if the patient consented to a community-resource referral. Required before a referral is drafted for any positive domain.
